subject.title: Bug: isRecurringTopOfHourCronExpr fails to match cron expressions with step values

question: Should maintainers adopt or replace the open linked cross-repo fix PR before allowing another repair lane for this issue?
rationale: The bug remains valid and narrow, but the issue is already paired with an unmerged, not-maintainer-editable cross-repo PR that proposes the same fix shape, so automation should not queue a duplicate fix until maintainers choose the route.

options.title: Replace with maintainer-editable fix
options.body: Use the linked PR as source context, preserve contributor credit where appropriate, and land a narrow target-repo PR with focused tests.

options.title: Adopt the linked PR directly
options.body: Work with the contributor or fork state to make the existing PR reviewable and landable instead of opening a replacement.

options.title: Reject broader minute-zero semantics
options.body: Decide that only literal minute-zero cron schedules should receive the default stagger, then update the issue/docs accordingly.

recommendation.title: Replace with maintainer-editable fix
recommendation.body: Use the linked PR as source context, preserve contributor credit where appropriate, and land a narrow target-repo PR with focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter introduced the default stagger surface and appears to be the strongest code-history owner for the cron defaulting behavior.
